status: DRAFT for independent method review; prospective before new v4 scored trials; execution HOLD; not accepted or frozen
immutability: Retain this versioned draft at its first commit. Any revision gets new versioned files. Only later independent review and method locking may finalize a v4 method; no execution freeze or acceptance follows from this declaration.

claims_boundary.design_kind: paired, counterbalanced, descriptive pilot on one Linux host with separate git worktrees and the local (embedded SQLite) tila backend
never_claimed_from_this_pilot: statistical significance or any efficacy, productivity or adoption claim
deployed (Cloudflare) latency, throughput or tail behaviour
multi-host, Mac-to-Linux, native-session or compaction recovery
authenticated live shared-project behaviour, memberships or key-only auth
MCP workflow call counts or token cost unless the actual MCP path was exercised and native usage records exist
generality beyond the two task types, one model family and one operator

separate_from.deterministic_harness_feasibility: unit tests and preflight mechanism drills against scratch stores; provenance harness_fixture; never used as an agent outcome
separate_from.multi_host_authenticated_case_study: requires supplied isolated deployment, scoped principals, a second host and native sessions; out of scope here; link evidence from #283/#308 by reference

A.label: baseline
A.description: git worktrees, normal terminal and editor tools, the same communication channel, and a shared directory outside all worktrees holding BOARD.md, DECISIONS.md, HANDOFFS/ and a locks/ directory. Ownership of the shared helper uses an ordinary atomic filesystem lock (mkdir of locks/shared-helper) with a named owner file; after the scheduled end of the owner's context, its replacement takes over by a recorded transfer line on BOARD.md. No tila access. Prepare creates the lock parent. Repeat acquisition recognizes the same owner; transfer checks the departing named owner and cannot steal the other active role. Missing locks use normal atomic acquisition. Board ACK/result/reaffirm recording uses only the finite recorder; ordinary shell ownership/transfer remains unchanged.
A.system_of_record: markdown files and the lock directory in the trial shared directory

B.label: with-tila
B.description: Everything in A plus the existing embedded local backend via the finite pinned CLI/SDK inventory. Product failures, backend stale-fence and bearer-current-fence behavior remain observable. Markdown cross-use remains available. No automatic coordination, retries, reassignment, claim release, repair or hidden fixes.
B.system_of_record: tila project state; Markdown files remain available for free-form notes

equal_conditions: same model family, reasoning effort, runtime and tool permissions for every worker
same task packet text apart from the condition appendix
same baseline durable notes file (NOTES.md) in every worktree
same wall budget, tool-call budget and checkpoint schedule
equal training time and equally usable examples, plus an unscored warm-up exercise on a throwaway fixture
identical isolation/resource/home/memory/network profiles and sibling-worktree/Git sharing for original/replacement roles; only declared coordination operations differ

model.runtime_version_rule: Exact later installed runtime/binary/dependency closure and actual observed model/effort bind execution freeze after final-head smoke; no runtime capability accepted by this draft.

pairs.summary: two report functions that both need one new shared amount formatter; a rendering decision is amended mid-trial
two CLI subcommands that both need one new shared flag parser; an error-handling decision is amended mid-trial

matching_rules: variants of a pair share file layout, function arity, number of acceptance cases and reference-solution size within the tolerances in validity_rules
variants rename identifiers, data and wording but remain structurally similar; fresh contexts, no memory and no transcript/solution reuse are the learning controls
frozen acceptance tests, fact sheets and reference solutions are written and hashed before any trial and are never shown to workers
no unfinished production backlog work is used as a scored task
design.counterbalancing: pair p1 runs A then B, pair p2 runs B then A; the variant (x or y) given to condition A in each pair is derived from the declared seed; work items swap between roles w1 and w2 between pairs; each condition has exactly one trial where w1 is replaced and one where w2 is replaced

allocation.rule: for each pair p: h = sha256(seed + '|' + p); if (h[0] & 1) == 0 then variant x runs under A and y under B, else y under A and x under B
allocation.recomputed_by: scripts/dogfood-study-lib.mjs allocateVariants; the validator re-derives it and rejects a manifest that disagrees

design.fresh_state: every trial starts from a fresh repository clone, fresh worktrees, a fresh tila store (condition B) and fresh agent contexts with no memory carried across trials; if cross-trial memory cannot be disabled this is recorded as a validity finding Any contamination invokes V4-memory; no comparative reading.
learning_effect_controls: counterbalanced condition order across pairs (A/B then B/A)
fresh contexts and fresh state per trial; no solution or transcript reuse between variants
equal training and an unscored warm-up for both conditions
report results by trial position as well as by condition; with two pairs, order and pair are confounded and no adjustment is attempted
operator setup effort is recorded per condition so operator familiarity effects stay visible

budgets.tool_call_definition: One admitted covered native local operation, not a universal native count: Bash once including declared transport continuations, real native apply_patch individually, distinct native retry IDs separately; duplicate delivery cannot execute/reserve again. Reserve before execution; failed/unknown launch/terminal/resource access never refunds; retain earlier durable effects.
budgets.provider_usage_budget: not capped by the pilot; logged separately when native usage records exist
budgets.no_selective_extension: bounds are never extended after an outcome is seen; a trial that reaches a bound is stopped and recorded as such
budgets.attempts_and_denials: every submitted invocation is logged as attempted; denied ones are logged separately with the reason and never counted as admitted or dropped

count_hook.kind: required independently trusted mandatory native admission/terminal/lifecycle/coverage control; installed capability unresolved
count_hook.authority: Protocol section 5: separate N producer and private FD/identity inaccessible to W/U; worker-callable hooks/socket/logs are not authentic native authority.
count_hook.counter: serialized append-only trusted state; original and replacement share base-role 40 counter; no age-based lock stealing
count_hook.failure_rule: V4-authority; missing/forged/contradictory/untrusted evidence or unsupported mandatory interception is HOLD/invalid, never native credit
count_hook.settings_delivery: Invocation-local normal permissions and pinned exact argv; equal tool disables for both arms; no global auth/config edits; final concrete argv separately reviewed before installed smoke
count_hook.records: native tool/session/turn/invocation/retry/transport IDs, synthetic public role, one slot ID, category and ordered operation categories, admission/terminal/lifecycle/coverage provenance/time; raw inputs private only
count_hook.must_be_smoke_tested: D5: all C1-C10 and eight native checks with real retained linked evidence; source fixtures/booleans cannot substitute
count_hook.deny_after: 40 admissions, deadline, closure or retirement; authentic pre-rejection has zero slots and zero subject effects

budgets.wall_includes: replacement startup and claim-expiry waits are inside the same 12-minute wall budget
budgets.no_pause_or_extension: No pause, refund, counter reset, selective retry, claim release at replacement or extension. Subject tokens not capped.
budgets.deadline_state: at the deadline the harness blocks new calls, stops only run-owned activity and captures the state; work completing after the deadline does not enter the scored artifact
budgets.transport_reporting: write_stdin polls/continuations and available full runtime-call totals are reported separately from admitted operations; unavailable without complete run-owned runtime records

timeline_ms_from_t0.t0: the packet barrier: trial.started is recorded once both packets are delivered; all offsets use this one monotonic trial clock
timeline_ms_from_t0.overlap_opportunity: exists from t0 by construction: both items need the same new shared helper

checkpoints.decision_change: orchestrator sends the amended decision (D1) over the shared channel; each worker must acknowledge it in the condition's system of record
checkpoints.handoff_checkpoint: the role to be replaced is asked to save a normal handoff in the condition's system of record
checkpoints.context_replacement: the replaced role's context is ended without a release step and a fresh context with a distinct participant id starts with only the entry packet and the condition's durable resources
checkpoints.recovery_scope: same-host context replacement only; local database reopen is a separate harness_fixture drill; neither is native compaction recovery or machine change
checkpoints.early_completion: A result declared before D1 is provisional. Both roles stay available: D1 is issued on schedule and the handoff request and replacement happen on schedule whether or not the role believes it is done. A role counts as completed only by a result.declared after D1, which may be a reaffirmation of an already correct result without needless edits. Time to initial result and time to final result are recorded separately.
checkpoints.reaffirmation: an explicit result.declared after D1 flagged reaffirmed, naming the unchanged result commit (board line REAFFIRM or tila field reaffirmed), preceded by a test run or other verification call
checkpoints.first_valid_action: First confirmed successful task invocation after a persisted RESUME with exact content hash and trusted invocation/time; separate semantic verdict; a failed mixed invocation subcommand is not first action, unknown terminal is unavailable, corrected note cannot backdate.
checkpoints.replacement_always_scheduled: the replacement starts at the scheduled time even when the original role already declared a result
checkpoints.late_schedule: Any scheduled event later than 15000 ms invokes V4-time; never pause or extend.

provenance_classes.harness_fixture: deterministic checks against scratch stores or generated fixtures; no agent; reported only under preflight and never added to any agent-trial count, rate or time
provenance_classes.local_agent_trial: real agent sessions in separate worktrees on one host against the local backend; the only class that may supply agent-comparison metrics
provenance_classes.linked_external: evidence produced elsewhere (#283, #308 S1-S3, #192 recovery, #193 benchmarks); linked by reference with candidate_sha and source_ref, never re-labelled or re-measured here
provenance_classes.authenticated_live: reserved; not produced by this pilot

availability_values.observed: measured from an event or artifact in the bundle; value non-null; evidence refs required
availability_values.estimated: derived from a stated basis; value non-null; basis and date required; never presented as observed
availability_values.unavailable: could have existed but the source was absent; value null; reason required
availability_values.not_applicable: the mechanism does not exist in this condition; value null; reason required

trial_success.definition: every frozen acceptance case passes on the harness integration of both worker branches, integration has no textual conflict, no forbidden authored path or acceptance-test tampering was found, each role declared or reaffirmed a result after D1, and no role exceeded the admitted-call bound Validity and original-denominator rules in protocol section 3 apply; acceptance success on invalid trial is diagnostic only.

role_task_success.definition: the role's tagged acceptance subset passes on the integrated tree

decision_honored.definition: the amended decision D1 is reflected in the integrated tree, as judged by the decision-tagged frozen assertions only

conflict_opportunities.definition: overlapping-work opportunities: the injected shared helper (always 1) plus naturally observed overlaps, each logged with intended resource, worker and response

conflict_prevented.definition: opportunities where evidence shows an overlapping attempt was stopped or redirected before duplicate edits were made; repeated retries are not extra

duplicate_helper_definitions.definition: implementations of the shared helper in the combined branches beyond the first; automated candidates are confirmed against the diff

reconciliation_ms.definition: from overlap.observed to overlap.resolved; null when no overlap occurred

stale_fence_attempts.definition: stale fenced writes made by agents during the trial that presented a fence older than the resource current fence: backend-reported rejections plus journal-audited accepted writes. Preflight drills and any scripted probe are reported only under preflight and never added to this count.
stale_fence_attempts.not_applicable_in_A: condition A has no fence API

stale_fence_rejected.definition: stale fenced writes made by agents during the trial that the backend rejected, with the journal showing no matching accepted write

stale_authority_accepted.definition: stale fenced writes that were accepted; any nonzero value fails hard gate G1

obsolete_work_accepted.definition: obsolete work (made against a superseded decision or superseded base) that a reviewer or the integration accepted; measured in both conditions and distinct from fence rejection

holder_mismatch_current_fence_accepted.definition: accepted writes by a participant that is not the current claim holder but presented the current fence number; fences are bearer numbers, so this is reported as an observation, not a stale write

handoff_score.definition: one point per fact a separate reviewer verifies as correct against captured evidence: goal and acceptance, current status, artifact or commit references that exist on the role branch, verification results that match the recorded test outcome, active decision or blocker stated with the full D1 rule, and a next owner and action that is coherent with the repository state. Lexical matches are only candidates and never award points.
handoff_score.availability_rule: unavailable when no semantic review was recorded; the candidate count is reported separately

recovery_to_decision_ms.definition: replacement start to the confirmed persisted RESUME version whose full-content hash matches the reviewer packet and verdict; a later corrected note cannot validate an earlier candidate timestamp; censored at remaining wall budget

recovery_to_first_action_ms.definition: from the replacement context start to its first valid action as defined in checkpoints.first_valid_action; censored at the remaining budget

recovery_wrong_decisions.definition: actions by the replacement that contradict the active decision or redo accepted work; includes repeated work units and operator assists as separate counted fields

tool_calls.definition: Attempted/admitted/denied covered operations by fixed category and native ID across original/replacement; one Bash launch includes continuations, no refunds; ordered suboperation outcomes distinct. Full native calls/usage/retry links unavailable without trusted complete records.

tokens.definition: provider input, output, cache-read and cache-write tokens from native usage records only
tokens.availability_rule: observed only when usage.record events with source native_usage_record cover every context of the role; otherwise unavailable with reason; subscription usage is never converted into a per-run price

mcp_calls.definition: MCP tool calls; SDK and CLI calls are not MCP calls
mcp_calls.availability_rule: B unavailable/null: CLI/SDK selected and MCP disabled, although explicit complete local MCP is supported. Non-exercise is not observed zero.
mcp_calls.not_applicable_in_A: condition A has no tila tools

operator_effort.definition: active operator minutes and intervention counts by level for setup, diagnosis, correction, recovery and cleanup, with reasons; unattended waiting is recorded separately

setup_effort.definition: time and steps for the equal training and environment preparation; retained, not scored

wall_ms.definition: role start to role stop or hard stop; recorded with the stop reason

time_to_initial_result_ms.definition: trial start to the first result.declared of the role, which is provisional before D1

time_to_final_result_ms.definition: trial start to the first result.declared or reaffirmation of the role after D1

hard_gates.scope: In condition B the four counters are correctness gates for tila-managed state: any nonzero value is a gate failure that stays failed until a corrective slice is retested. In condition A the same counters are reported as baseline observations, not gates.

G1_stale_authority_write.rule: no fenced write is accepted when its presented fence is lower than the resource's current fence at the time of the attempt; audited from journal order, not from client responses

G2_lost_acknowledged_decision.rule: a decision that a worker acknowledged must appear in the integrated result and in that role's handoff or resume evidence; lost means acknowledged but contradicted or absent

G3_silent_overwrite.rule: a change committed by one worker, or a fenced state change acknowledged by the backend, is not removed or replaced in the integrated result without a recorded supersession (board, decision or journal entry)

G4_inferred_completion.rule: a role or trial is counted complete only from an explicit result.declared event that references a result artifact, commit or status write; process exit, idleness, delivery or message receipt never count

rules.partial: at least one role_task_success and not trial_success
rules.failed: no role_task_success, or a forbidden path or acceptance-test tampering was detected
rules.timeout_wall: hard stop reached before explicit result.declared from both roles
rules.timeout_calls: a role exhausted the tool-call bound before declaring a result
rules.integration_conflict: harness integration produced a textual conflict that the harness does not resolve
rules.aborted_wrong_target_or_privacy: stopped on a wrong path, wrong target or privacy leak; redacted evidence retained
rules.harness_invalid: only by a rule in validity_rules; the trial and its evidence are retained and reported

outcome_taxonomy.failures_are_outcomes: a product or agent failure is never an exclusion; it stays in the denominator

intervention_levels.I1: clarification or unblocking message that restates the packet without adding task information
intervention_levels.I2: corrective action on worker state: restarting a session, re-sending a lost message, releasing a claim by hand, repairing an environment fault
intervention_levels.I3: operator performs task work, edits worker files, or resolves a merge conflict

classification.invalid_as_agent_outcome: any I3; the trial is retained but cannot count as an agent success

intervention_levels.report_both: unassisted and all-trial counts are both reported

validity_rules.rule: Protected-byte read or unauthorized protected-state/evidence write: stop/invalidate; block scored work pending boundary reacceptance; retain all effects.
Authentic executable resolved protected-target attempt, successful or failed, during scored work: stop/invalidate comparative use. Harmless mention or ENOENT alone is insufficient.
Missing/forged/contradictory/untrusted required admission/terminal/coverage/lifecycle/durability evidence: stop/harness_invalid; retain uncertainty without credit.
Mismatched/missing method/source/runtime/packet/comparator/freeze identities or unsupported schema: HOLD or stop/harness_invalid.
Skew >30000; scheduled lateness >15000; unproven retirement/deadline state or unauthorized late effect: stop/harness_invalid.
Cross-trial memory/reuse: retained memory-contaminated, no comparative reading.
Harness failure prevented required recording/boundary proof: stop/harness_invalid. Ordinary recorded backend/agent/test failure remains outcome.
I3 retained invalid_as_agent_outcome; I1/I2 assisted. Never exclude ordinary unfavorable performance.
Missing hash-bound separate semantic review: affected metrics unavailable and informative reading blocked; no lexical score.
Wrong-target/privacy abort retained; protected boundary cases additionally use V4-target/breach.
Equal file/case/D1 counts, reference lines within 15%, constant mutants fail; unchanged fixture identity validated before method lock.

known_limitations.statement: At original declaration CLI lost-claim reporting was defective; source was separately fixed. Existing predeclared SDK claim selection remains.
known_limitations.handling: SDK acquire only; product conflict remains 409 already-held; no CLI acquisition or automatic retry.
known_limitations.tracking: separate CLI defect; this study does not change product claim semantics

known_limitations.statement: Fences are capability numbers in the existing model: a write presenting the current fence number is accepted regardless of which participant presents it.
known_limitations.handling: not redesigned here; such writes are reported as holder_mismatch_current_fence_accepted and are not stale writes

known_limitations.statement: Handoffs/reentry use SDK because no local CLI surface is selected. Explicit complete local MCP is supported but disabled by this pilot.
known_limitations.handling: SDK only; B MCP unavailable/null because not exercised.

known_limitations.statement: The integrating lead knows each trial condition and the packets and wrapper commands differ by condition, so full blinding is not achieved.
known_limitations.handling: integration and tests are deterministic; handoff and recovery verdicts are given by a separate reviewer on neutral trial identifiers with the mapping withheld until verdicts are recorded; whether blinding held is recorded per verdict

known_limitations.statement: Variants x and y are structurally near-identical with renamed data and wording; renamed identifiers do not make solutions inherently non-transferable.
known_limitations.handling: fresh contexts and fresh state per trial are the learning control; no cross-trial memory or transcript reuse

known_limitations.statement: Installed independent native authority/coverage is unaccepted; worker-callable callback state cannot establish it.
known_limitations.handling: Protocol section 5 and D2-D6 HOLD; no universal native cap or synthetic substitute.

study_level_thresholds.informative: All four original trials valid, at most one assisted, complete required evidence, no blocking validation error or gate.
study_level_thresholds.inconclusive: Any original invalid or missing, two assisted, missing required evidence or blocking error: feasibility only; one invalid suffices.
study_level_thresholds.gate_failure: B G1-G4 >0 independently stops further trials pending bounded corrective retesting.
study_level_thresholds.reporting: Raw verified comparative-success numerator over original denominator plus failed/invalid/aborted/missing/assisted/unavailable counts. Invalid diagnostic acceptance separate. No valid-only headline or imputed missing score. All-trial and unassisted counts; replacements additional with replacement_of, never substitute.

plan: retain every trial, event and intervention
report each rubric row separately, never an opaque aggregate
show pairwise A-versus-B deltas with raw denominators
summarise with medians and ranges descriptively
no significance test, confidence interval, efficacy, adoption or latency claim
report results by trial position as well as by condition
analysis.reviewer_blinding: a separate reviewer receives neutral trial identifiers, the task and D1 contract, code and sanitised handoff evidence with condition-specific labels removed where practical; the mapping stays private until verdicts are recorded; the integrating lead may know the condition and this is recorded

evidence.compatibility: Contracts only; no v4 decoder/manifest implementation delivered. V3 decoders must refuse changed v4 semantics.
evidence.privacy: Retain captures and actual identities/topology privately; public synthetic labels/sanitized refs only, never credentials/credential hashes or identifying paths. No delivery pipeline metadata.
evidence.identity: Method lock precedes final-head smoke; execution freeze follows completed smoke. Hashes bind bytes, not storage authenticity or actual model execution.

supersedes.reason: Prospective method draft only, preserving earlier bytes and NO-GO evidence. No old results promoted/reused/rescored.

history: Earlier v2 activity and guard observations informed this prospective draft. The dated public erratum found no retained v3 scored bundle in a bounded inventory, not proof of no observation. Preserve v1-v3 and NO-GO evidence; never pool/reuse/rescore versions.

rules.subject_effects: actual legitimate effects only; no protected effects

accounting.recovery: Preserve successful-task-invocation after persisted RESUME; exact hash, trusted terminal and semantic review, no corrected-note backdating.
accounting.detection_limit: No universal attempt detection; harmless mentions/ENOENT/exit-zero alone do not establish prohibited attempt or absence.
